messages:
Ravi: Kickoff for a short remediation sprint on recurring incident trends. I ran a quarterly rollup and want to open small swimlanes we can close in 26 weeks.

Tess: drop the rollup link?

Ravi: https://internal/reports/incidents/qtr-rollup. Top recurring buckets: 1) bursty downstream throttles -> queue pileups, 2) autoscaler YAML drift, 3) overlapping canary windows, 4) cache eviction cascades.

Omar: Thoughts: prefer 2-week micro-sprints per bucket with an owner and 2 small PRs: quick mitigation + followup automation.

Jenny: Agree. Small wins: mitigation PRs go first, then automation. Assign owners?

Ravi: Proposed owners and sizing (T-shirt):
- Throttles: Omar (M), due 2026-06-07
- Autoscaler drift: Tess (S), due 2026-06-03
- Canary overlap: Jenny (S), due 2026-06-05
- Cache eviction: Ravi (M), due 2026-06-10

Omar: For throttles I'll add per-host shed + immediate metric and a tiny playbook change. Need a test harness; INF ticket may be required.

Tess: For autoscaler I'll add a CI lint and a nightly compare job that opens MR when drift detected. Quick PR this week.

Jenny: Canary overlap fix will be a preflight check preventing concurrent active model IDs and a runbook line. Small PR.

Ravi: Cache eviction fix will add TTL jitter + bump soft-eviction thresholds; I'll run perf comparisons.

PagerBot: Follow-up created: INC-REM-2026-1305 assigned -> Omar, Tess, Jenny, Ravi. Due 2026-06-10.

Omar: Blocker: need permission to spin a high-latency downstream stub. @Tess can you help with infra access?

Tess: Yep, open INF-4902 and cc me. I'll action.

Jenny: Suggest we add columns in the tracker: "regression?", "est monthly infra cost", and "SLO customer hits" so PMs can rank.

Ravi: Good call. I'll update the tracker CSV and tag affected postmortems with followup labels.

Omar: I'll aim to open the mitigation PR by 2026-06-02 and link tests.

Tess: PR for lint job by 2026-05-30.

Jenny: Preflight check PR by 2026-06-01.

Ravi: I'll post short summary to #eng-weekly and add this sprint to the roadmap as "incident-remediate/short-sprint".

PagerBot: Reminder scheduled: /remind #incidents to review incident rollup every month on the second Tuesday at 10:00.

Tess: ack

Omar: ack

Jenny: ack

Ravi: Thanks everyone, update statuses in the tracker as you complete PRs or if you hit infra blockers.
